items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, you mean tall, tongue-tall, working for the city or something?

ctx.x: Was Roscoe Legnan playing with him? I believe so.
I don't know what you're talking about. I don't know. I don't remember. I knew a guy named Larry Labatt. I know a guy named Larry Labatt that used to play trumpet with him.
But Labatt used to go to school with George at Warren Easton.
